subject: infoschema: fix TableName2ID case sensitivity issue (#65139)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent: single behavior change in `pkg/infoschema/builder.go` switches `delete(di.TableName2ID, ...)` from `t.Name.L` to `t.Name.O`, aligning with the producer `meta.GetAllNameToIDAndTheMustLoadedTableInfo` (extracts table name from JSON "O" field) so mixed-case names are correctly removed when building infoschema under schema-cache mode. Added regression tests in `pkg/infoschema/builder_test.go`; no subsequent upstream/master changes touching this logic after the commit.
